differences.what: A's product fills more of the frame and sits closer to centre, so it carries a homepage hero; B's speaker is small with a lot of empty sweep above it, so it reads as a catalogue shot
B has a heavy grey vignette in the top-left corner that looks like a dirty backdrop; A's falloff there is softer and cleaner
B's horn has crisper rim highlights and more contrast around the throat, so it reads as solid coloured glass; A's horn washes out to flat pink on its left half
A's lower ports and electronics box are larger and more legible, with a clean screw-plate and port-tube read; in B the same detail is smaller and a little muddier
Both have a pink colour spill on the floor below the base. In B it fans out wider and harder toward the bottom edge and looks more like an artefact
